'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Sean McGrath DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Sean McGrath]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title Hunt Down. Includes [[Drop! (V)]]. Visage×2.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Sean McGrath]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
